Naturally I asked how long I should monitor for before returning for further investigation. To which he said, “ah you want an exact date - let’s say 5th of May at 1330”. I was astounded at how patronising, insensitive and extremely unprofessional he was. Absolutely no compassion or care, quite the contrary to what characteristics you’d expect from a GP.

Unfortunately over the last months his health has deteriorated and as such I have had to make fairly regular contact with the clinic.  Its easy to complain about thing but I have to see wholeheartedly that the care, compassion and service we have received has been wonderful.

Each time I have called I have been treated with respect , been listened to , been updated and called back with updates.
Having dealt with a few members of the team Joanne and Emma they have been both extremely helpful and polite,

Emma in particular I feel has gone above and beyond in dealing with my dads situation.  Her telephone manner comes across as genuine, caring and empathetic.  She has been extremely efficient in dealing with each call I have made and she has been extremely responsive.

Recently following a recent discharge from hospital I popped into the clinic and spoke to Emma in person as I was concerned things would not go smooth with his care package - including prescription.  Emma listened, noted and responded to each request.  She updated us thereafter and everything was put into place.  From arranging the prescription service, a home visit (thank you Dr Strang for your care and professionalism) and also district nurse referral.  Thank you Emma your help has been very much appreciated and our family cannot thank you enough for your help, support and care.  I hope Forth Medical Group appreciate what an asset you are.",null,[0,238]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSYU5YaHFUelZIWlhObGVIUjFkM0l4VWt0NFVuYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x58f992114f23871b!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOkRaNXhqTzVHZXNleHR1d3IxUkt4Unc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSYU5YaHFUelZIWlhObGVIUjFkM0l4VWt0NFVuYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi0gazM57eTAxWiMmMBHeo_N34QoykIFigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi0gazM57eTAxWiMmMBHeo_N34Q0pMFCBQoBg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMlZmVkdvM1FsOWZSV2hEU0RoSWFqSldNVXh6YW5ZMWVEbHdUVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpWYjBOYU56bFBVSE5GV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21VMGVrOTRaR3BLWjA5alQxOW5TMGRpWVhkTlZWRRAB",["0x0:0x58f992114f23871b",null,1749801254824071,1749801254824071,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/109194586203430555507/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Nee Route","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLxphA-Jedp2nGkte3IQW014dlKHIPzvzkKXSc5F4IsoVZGDA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/109194586203430555507?hl=en"],"109194586203430555507",null,4,0,null,[0,3,1],0,["4 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi0gazM57eTAxWiMmMBHeo_N34Q7LoGCBgoAA"]]]],null,"9 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I am registered with Bannockburn branch.
